title: Finds anonymous namespaces in headers.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Warn about confusable identifiers, i.e. identifiers that are visually close to each other, but use different Unicode characters.
summary: This detects a potential attack described in CVE-2021-42574. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds local variables and function parameters which could be declared as const but are not.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Detects when objects of certain hostile RAII types persists across suspension points in a coroutine.
summary: Such hostile types include scoped-lockable types and types belonging to a configurable denylist. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds non-extern non-inline function and variable definitions in header files, which can lead to potential ODR violations in case these headers are included from multiple translation units.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Checks that constructors callable with a single argument and conversion operators are marked explicit to avoid the risk of unintentional implicit conversions.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Check detects cyclic #include dependencies between user-defined headers.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Checks for unused and missing includes.
summary: Generates findings only for the main file of a translation unit. Findings correspond to https://clangd.llvm.org/design/include-cleaner. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns about unterminated bidirectional unicode sequence, detecting potential attack as described in the Trojan Source attack.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds identifiers that contain Unicode characters with right-to-left direction, which can be confusing as they may change the understanding of a whole statement line, as described in Trojan Source.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: This check diagnoses when a const qualifier is applied to a typedef/ using to a pointer type rather than to the pointee, because such constructs are often misleading to developers because the const applies to the pointer rather than the pointee.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns if a class inherits from multiple classes that are not pure virtual.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Cert-dcl54-cpp redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds strongly connected functions (by analyzing the call graph for SCC's (Strongly Connected Components) that are loops), diagnoses each function in the cycle, and displays one example of a possible call graph loop (recursion).
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Cert-fio38-c redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds virtual function overrides with different visibility than the function in the base class.
summary: This includes for example if a virtual function declared as private is overridden and declared as public in a subclass. The detected change is the modification of visibility resulting from keywords public, protected, private at overridden virtual functions. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns for the usage of std::rand().
summary: Pseudorandom number generators use mathematical algorithms to produce a sequence of numbers with good statistical properties, but the numbers produced are not genuinely random. The std::rand() function takes a seed (number), runs a mathematical operation on it and returns the result. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Detect redundant expressions which are typically errors due to copy-paste.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Cert-dcl03-c redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds cyclical initialization of static variables.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Cert-err09-cpp and cert-err61-cpp redirect here as aliases of this check.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds declarations of assign operators with the wrong return and/or argument types and definitions with good return type but wrong return statements.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Find and replace unique_ptr::reset(release()) with std::move().
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds unused namespace alias declarations.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds unused function parameters.
summary: Unused parameters may signify a bug in the code (e.g. when a different parameter is used instead). The suggested fixes either comment parameter name out or remove the parameter completely, if all callers of the function are in the same translation unit and can be updated. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds unused using declarations.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds instances of static functions or variables declared at global scope that could instead be moved into an anonymous namespace.
summary: The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.

title: Detects variables, functions, and classes that can be marked as static or (in C++) moved into an anonymous namespace to enforce internal linkage.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the misc module of clang-tidy.
